{{Quote|Captain Gunn, like to hear more about the war in Republic space. I invite you and your passengers to be honored guests on the Random Mallet.|Hethra Mcgrrrr, to [[Lalo Gunn]]|<ref name="CWSM2" />}}
The '''''Random Mallet''''' was a hammer-shaped [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] owned by the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Hethra Mcgrrrr/Legends|Hethra Mcgrrrr]] and his men, the [[Black Hole Gang/Legends|Black Hole Gang]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the ''Random Mallet'' was trapped within the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] by the [[Gravity/Legends|gravitational]] pull of a [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]].<ref name="CWSM2" />
